borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of scale, siting, design, bulk, mass and appearance would be an undesirable addition, representing an overly dominant and disproportionate extension to the dwelling.&nbsp; The rear extension would sit be a significant addition to the rear of the terrace dwelling, impacting the character and symmetry of the and failing to appear as subordinate.&nbsp; As such,&nbsp; the proposal would cause undue harm to the character and appearance of the host dwelling and surrounding area, including the historic distinctiveness of the Becontree Estate. The proposal is therefore contrary to the following policies which seek to ensure that development recognises local character and promotes good design whilst protecting and enhancing historic environments:&nbsp;- National Planning Policy Framework&nbsp;National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021)- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)-&nbsp;Policies SP2, DMD1, DMD4 and DMD5 of&nbsp;The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September 2024)

<p>The proposed development, by reason of its scale, siting and design would cause severe harm to the neighbouring occupiers.&nbsp; The proposed development fails to be appropriately setback from adjoining boundaries, and fails to mitigate any significant impact to the amenity of neighbouring dwellings. Due to its excessive depth, the proposed development would result in a significant level of overbearing, loss of outlook and overshadowing to occur. The proposed development therefore constitutes unneighbourly development and is contrary to:</p><p><br></p><p>- National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)</p><p>- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021);</p><p>- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012);</p><p>- Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMD5 of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September 2024)</p>
